parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Valid values: If NextToken is empty, no next query exists. If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query.

parameters.name: ResourceCategoryId
parameters.description: The resource category ID. Filters the resource calculation results by the specified resource category. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied. You can specify multiple resource category IDs separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: ResourceOwnerIds
parameters.description: The list of resource owner IDs, used in cross-account unified management. Filters the resource calculation results by the specified accounts. If this parameter is not specified, data of the current logon account is returned.

parameters.name: ResourceRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource. Filters the resource calculation results by the specified region. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied. You can specify multiple region IDs separated by commas (,).
